speaker: Doctor
text:
The normal IgM core antibody result suggests this is not an acute infection, but rather a chronic Hepatitis B infection, which is consistent with the positive surface and envelope antigens. Given the significantly elevated liver enzymes and clinical symptoms, this represents an acute exacerbation of chronic Hepatitis B.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Hepatitis B with acute exacerbation
